title: Product Milestone 10 — Commercial Subscriptions, Payments and Entitlements

tasks.title: Approve FREE and PREMIUM plan taxonomy
acceptance_criteria: FREE, PREMIUM_MONTHLY and PREMIUM_YEARLY are versioned; enterprise remains future-only.

tasks.title: Define plan superseding and availability
acceptance_criteria: Plan retirement never deletes subscription history.

tasks.title: Map FREE feature package
acceptance_criteria: Every FREE capability is entitlement-controlled and configurable.

tasks.title: Map PREMIUM feature package
acceptance_criteria: Premium access includes coaching and analytics under fair use without client-side trust.

tasks.title: Compare India launch payment options
acceptance_criteria: Razorpay, UPI and cards are compared without subscription or integration.

tasks.title: Compare future channel providers
acceptance_criteria: Google Play, Apple, Stripe and PayPal remain future evaluation options.

tasks.title: Specify subscription state machine
acceptance_criteria: Trial through restore states and legal transitions are explicit.

tasks.title: Specify reconciliation and evidence
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate, late and missing events are idempotently reconcilable and auditable.

tasks.title: Define provider-neutral entitlement contract
acceptance_criteria: Entitlements contain no payment-provider logic.

tasks.title: Define entitlement version and audit policy
acceptance_criteria: Every access decision identifies the rule version and source subscription.

tasks.title: Model configurable usage dimensions
acceptance_criteria: Daily/monthly requests, voice, tokens, AI cost and fair-use thresholds are configurable.

tasks.title: Define fair-use enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Warnings, throttling and review are learner-safe and never marketed as technically unlimited.

tasks.title: Define founder KPI catalogue
acceptance_criteria: Growth, subscription, revenue, margin, learning and AI-cost metrics have formulas and owners.

tasks.title: Define dashboard privacy and freshness
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are aggregated, privacy-safe, timestamped and source-traceable.

tasks.title: Design cohort and retention analysis
acceptance_criteria: Cohorts, retention and funnels use stable denominators and time windows.

tasks.title: Design feature and cost analysis
acceptance_criteria: Feature, lesson and AI-cost trends distinguish estimates from billed values.

tasks.title: Prepare legal document placeholders
acceptance_criteria: All eight required legal/disclosure artifacts have owner and approval placeholders.

tasks.title: Define acceptance and version evidence
acceptance_criteria: Required terms acceptance records version, learner, locale and timestamp.

tasks.title: Build three variable pricing scenarios
acceptance_criteria: Scenarios use variables, never hard-coded launch prices.

tasks.title: Define margin and break-even formulas
acceptance_criteria: Revenue, AI, hosting, gateway fees, margin and break-even are scenario outputs.

tasks.title: Assess payment and abuse risks
acceptance_criteria: Failure, fraud, refunds, chargebacks, misuse and shared accounts have controls and owners.

tasks.title: Assess cost and provider risks
acceptance_criteria: AI spikes and provider outages have budgets, kill switches and fallback plans.

tasks.title: Assemble commercial recommendation
acceptance_criteria: Every recommendation cites evidence or remains explicitly undecided.

tasks.title: Record human scope decision
acceptance_criteria: Only a named human can authorize implementation, provider activation or deployment.

business_rules.rule: Plan identity and entitlement versions are immutable.
Payment providers never determine learning access directly.
FREE limits are configurable and never negative.
Premium unlimited claims are governed by disclosed fair use.
Webhook events require signature verification before processing.
Payment events are idempotent and replay-safe.
Grace access has an explicit bounded duration.
Upgrade and downgrade effective dates are deterministic.
Refunds do not erase financial or entitlement audit evidence.
Usage counters are owner-scoped and idempotent.
AI cost metrics distinguish estimates from provider billing.
Pricing values are configuration approved by a human.
Legal acceptance is versioned and timestamped.
Children's privacy remains a mandatory legal gate.
Credentials never enter plans, logs or analytics.
No provider activation or public release occurs from planning.

limitations: no native Android app in scope
no native iOS app in scope
